newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 5.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Policeman shot dead, second in three days
Smoking in public places to be punishable by maximum T$3,000 (US$109) fine.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Jiang Zemin expected to visit United States in November.
Government demolishes more than 300 illegal buildings to make space for city parks.
LIBERTY TIMES - Two police officers suspected of involvement in gambling on professional baseball games.
Taiwan futures trading to commence in October.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Beijing office of EVA Airways to begin operation on March 12.
President Enterprises to establish investment trust firm in China.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Only half of spouse's inheritance will be subject to taxation after death of spouse.
Debates abound concerning whether or not stock market is "too hot".
